scope: Brand-teal landscape artwork, desktop split/flip/fan, mobile scroll stack, no arrows or carousel input handlers, natural reading fallbacks.

productionBuild.note: Used the documented Webpack fallback after the sandboxed Turbopack CSS worker exited before connecting. The default build script is unchanged.

visualReview.method: Rendered Chrome screenshots plus the current in-app browser. Desktop opening, separation, flip and reading hold; phone/tablet story holds; natural-flow short-screen fallback.
visualReview.coverageLimit: Chrome viewport emulation and desktop in-app browser, not real-device Safari coverage.

artwork.method: One built-in image-editing attempt, followed by WebP compression. No Higgsfield generation.

deployment: Not deployed. Existing local development server remains available at http://127.0.0.1:3000/.
